मज्ज् cl. 6. P. (Dhātup. xxviii, 122) मज्जति (Ved. मज्जति, ep. also ˚ते; pf. ममज्ज [2. sg. ममज्जिथ, or ममङ्क्थ] MBh.; aor. [मा] मज्जीस्, ib.; अमाङ्क्षीत्, Bhaṭṭ.; Prec. मज्ज्यात्, ŚBr.; fut. मङ्क्ष्यति, ˚ते, Br. &c.; मज्जिष्यति, MBh.; मङ्क्ता Gr.; inf. मज्जितुम्, MBh.; मङ्क्तुम् Gr.; ind.p. मङ्क्त्वा or मक्त्वा, ib.; मज्ज्य, AV.), to sink (into), (acc. or loc.), go down, go to hell, perish, become ruined, RV. &c. &c.; to sink (in water), dive, plunge or throw one's self into (loc.), bathe, be submerged or drowned, ṢaḍvBr.; KātyŚr.; MBh. &c.: Caus. मज्जयति (aor. अममज्जत् Gr.), to cause to sink, submerge, drown, overwhelm, destroy, ŚBr. &c. &c.; to inundate, MBh.; to strike or plant into (loc.), ib. : Desid. मिमङ्क्षति or मिमज्जिषति Gr. (cf. मिमङ्क्षा) : Intens. मामज्ज्यते, मामङ्क्ति, ib.
